children: Cerenome announced a suite of financing agreements anchored by a senior secured convertible note program totaling $21.3 million in original principal, with an initial $3.0 million closing expected on September 10, 2026. The notes carry an 8% interest rate, a 6% original issue discount, a one-year maturity, and an initial conversion price of $2.74 per share with a $0.50 floor. The company also agreed to a 2.5% revenue-based royalty tied to CNSide, investor resale registration rights for conversion shares, and a first-priority security interest over substantially all assets. Proceeds will support working capital and general corporate purposes, while the package balances investor protections with future flexibility for additional closings within 18 months.
